description: Synthetic gate under the historical raw per-environment alpha rule versus the manuscript rule (BH at q=0.05 across the supplied environments), side by side. Same seeds, B=500, same null draws (both rules call _precision_null_values in the same order), so only the decision differs.

field_definitions.gate_count: environments the gate detects among those supplied (E2: per seed; E2c/E4 starvation: per random subset, BH applied within the subset)
field_definitions.verdict_counts: PROCEED / PROCEED_CAPPED / ABSTAIN over seeds (or subsets)
field_definitions.certified_recovery_mean: E2 schema value; not defined for starvation series
field_definitions.gate_first_restricts: first level where not every seed PROCEEDs (E2 crossover_gate_leaves_proceed; E2c crossover_gate_first_restricts)
field_definitions.mcc_first_below_0p90: first level where mean ungated MCC < 0.90
field_definitions.decided_pair_errors: E1 capped: shd_decided + n_committed_uncovered per seed

e4_raw_source_note: The A100 raw E4 JSONs are not committed in this repo. The raw E4 columns come from a Mac rerun of rule=raw with the same code (scratch, not committed); sha256 values below identify those files.
